required_transformations: Aggregate signup_date and city_tier to produce daily_signup_count_by_city_tier
Compute conversion rate using converted_flag grouped by acquisition_channel
Calculate 7-day retention rate using retained_7d_flag grouped by cohort_week
Remove all user-level identifiers and contact information from final output
justification: All business questions can be answered with aggregate outputs, making raw user-level export unnecessary
Policy requires minimization: only the smallest field set needed to compute aggregates is allowed for internal query
Password_hash and auth_token are credential materials that must never be released externally
Derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) are preferred over raw timestamps as they directly support the business questions
